title: Add ruff and a formatter; fix the undefined name and mutable ContextVar defaults
description:
No linter, formatter or type checker runs anywhere. ruff with defaults plus B and UP reports 999 findings, among them real defects: LabeledItem is undefined in two annotations in src/decision_flywheel/embedded_cyclotron.py (:348 and :578; it survives only because of postponed annotations); ContextVar defaults are mutable (flywheel.py:194 and :198); 52 unused imports; a try/except/pass in priming.py:231; unused locals in diagnosis.py:169 and trace_step_projection.py:68. Formatting also diverges: the storage and S3 modules use self.storage=storage, if x:do() on one line and no spaces around operators, against the rest of the package.
Do: add [tool.ruff] to pyproject.toml with a small rule set (F, B, UP, I) and a line length matching the code (the package has 1,926 lines over 120 characters, so pick 130 or exclude E501), fix every F and B finding by hand (do not auto-fix blindly in a 53k-line package; review each), run ruff format once in its own commit so blame stays readable, and add ruff check and ruff format --check to make check. Keep the user's preference: long descriptive names, no explanatory comments.
Done when: ruff check and ruff format --check pass on develop, the undefined name is imported, make test passes. Review doc: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/dcd5a089-28f1-4a3f-9f2f-a293789709c0 (Cyclotron review, 2026-10-17).
